work_order: ProofBridge Delivery Round — Deliverable 1 (real-data fraud validation)

dataset.note: official reduced subset of ai-lab/MBD (same schema); full detail table is 38 GB

selection.rule: client_split fold=0 ORDER BY client_id LIMIT 2000

label_rule.disclosed_rule: inbound contact within 24h of payment and no payment_review navigation between payee_add and payment = positive
label_rule.payment: every trx row (direction not expressible in anonymised MBD schema)
label_rule.payee_add: counterparty (dst_type11,dst_type12) first seen for the client within the preceding 30 days
label_rule.inbound_contact: any dialog event in [t-24h, t) (before-side; direction not expressible)
label_rule.payment_review: any dialog event in [t-2h, t) (quiet-window proxy; dialog navigation types not expressible)
label_rule.positive: recently-added payee AND contact-24h-before AND no-dialog-2h-before

sample_proxies.gapDraw: real seconds since previous same-client trx; first event 30d
sample_proxies.hour: native wall-clock hour, no timezone conversion

geo_note: geo rows are loaded and counted (sequences built from all three tables) but enter neither labels nor samples; the disclosed rule's observables are trx+dialog only
determinism: pinned revision + fold + client count => byte-identical outputs; no wall-clock reads
